method: Independent source/pin and complete saved-record comparison only; no ray, ODE, analytic-action or inverse rerun.
findings: Frozen core and helper exactly match the independently tested D integration candidate; C++ harness and all invented inputs are unchanged.
All saved row differences and column counts match the reported comparison. Every non-time evaluation field and all final-path/parity bytes are unchanged.
Two budget-exhausted local failures and 32 source-accuracy failures remain distinct from 836 passing arithmetic/parity checks.
Positive-guide epsilon-zero paths still stop without updates and retain the fixed-polygon first-element source partial; D cannot repair that representation by improving curvature arithmetic.
This bounded repeat supplies no evidence of a native benefit and does not justify repeating the native mesh ladder solely with D.
limitations: D changes outer accumulation as well as usable curvature relative to old001; this is not a retention-only causal test.
Intermediate optimizer histories were not saved; final-table equality does not prove equality of every internal step.
